title: Fleet event log record v1
description: One line of a strategy's append-only fleet event log. Every operator-visible detection is recorded here and nothing here notifies anybody; a condition that crossed a threshold additionally opens an error request. Codes are the bare condition names the strategies emit -- the log is per project, so the catalog prefix is added by readers.

code.description: Bare condition name, never a prefixed catalog code.

risk_tier.description: The catalog tier as resolved when the event was written, or null when the writer did not resolve one. Recorded for audit only; this log never decides a tier.

evidence.description: Stable facts identifying this occurrence; the input a request fingerprint is derived from.

details.description: Diagnostic context that may differ between two records of the same occurrence.

measurements.description: Numeric indicators for conditions that are only a metric (a single reconciliation delta lands here and escalates nothing).
